description: Build the crate: the napi-rs .node, wasm-bindgen output, Python extension or shared library. With `profile: "android"`, build the JNI library for Android ABIs into `jniLibs/` (needs the NDK and the Rust Android targets; returned as {ndk, api, libraries} instead of {artifact}).

abi.description: Android ABIs; defaults to arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64.

crate.description: Folder of the generated crate (holds rust-anything.json).

jni_libs.description: Where to install the Android libraries; defaults to <crate>/jniLibs.

ndk.description: Android NDK root; found from ANDROID_NDK_HOME or the SDK when omitted.

profile.description: Build for this machine (default) or for Android.

name: build
title: Build crate
